Mountain Biking in the Andes

4

The Valle Sagrado de los Incas offers spectacular routes for downhill and cross-country mountain biking. Surrounded by towering peaks and ancient terraces, this region is a paradise for outdoor enthusiasts.

Highlighted Locations:

  • The sacred valley of the inkas
  • Moray

Panoramic views, winding Andean trails, and diverse terrain make this one of the best adventure activities in Cusco. Whether you’re an experienced rider or a beginner looking for a thrill, mountain biking in the Andes delivers an unforgettable rush.

Rafting on the Urubamba River

For water adrenaline seekers, rafting on the Río Urubamba offers Class II and III rapids, perfect for beginners and intermediate adventurers.

This activity blends excitement with breathtaking scenery, flowing through the heart of the Sacred Valley. It’s an excellent way to combine culture and adventure in one powerful experience.

Rock Climbing & Via Ferrata in the Sacred Valley

4

Would you dare to sleep hanging from a mountain?

In the Sacred Valley, you can climb a via ferrata route and spend the night in transparent capsules like those at Skylodge Adventure Suites.

This is a once-in-a-lifetime experience designed for extreme travelers seeking height, adrenaline, and breathtaking views of the Andes.

Tips for Adventure Tourism in Cusco

If you’re planning extreme adventures in Cusco, keep these tips in mind:

  • Acclimatize for 1–2 days before doing high-altitude activities.
  • Stay constantly hydrated.
  • Book with certified and professional tour operators.
  • Check weather conditions before each excursion.

Proper preparation ensures a safe and unforgettable adventure.

Why Choose Cusco for Adventure Tourism?

Cusco combines:

  • Imposing Andean mountains
  • Living Inca history
  • Diverse ecosystems (highlands, valleys, rivers)
  • Activities suitable for all adventure levels

It is one of the most complete destinations in Latin America for extreme adventure tourism.

Adventure travel in Cusco goes far beyond visiting Machu Picchu. From trekking in the Andes to rafting sacred rivers, every experience blends culture, nature, and adrenaline.

If you’re looking for a journey that pushes your limits and rewards you with unforgettable landscapes, Cusco is your next destination with GT Peru Travel.
